seo_title: Soznikar: Shopify Store Design and Build | The Brandle
summary: A Shopify store for hand-loomed Kashmiri pashmina, sold into the Gulf.

brief.label: Luxury retail
brief.heading: The brief
paras: Soznikar sells hand-loomed Kashmiri pashmina ghutras to the Gulf. Every piece is woven and embroidered by hand, so the store had to carry detail and provenance rather than shout about discounts.
It is our own brand. That made us the client, and we can confirm the client was difficult.

answer.label: Shopify store
answer.heading: The build
paras: A Shopify storefront, designed and built in-house, in English and Arabic. The home page opens on one line, "Woven in Kashmir. Worn in the Gulf.", and then gets out of the way of the cloth.
There is a page for the ghutra, a page for the heritage behind it, and product pages that give the craft room to speak. Nobody has ever been talked into pashmina by a pop-up.
